authority.document: ODA Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.scope: Section 20.1 object frame and common prologue; it does not establish these out-of-version class body semantics.

revolve.crc: independently checked from source frame using repository research CRC implementation

change: After failed typed parsing, exact AC1014 RENDERGLOBAL/AcDbRenderGlobal frames use the existing unmodeled render carrier. Exact AC1014 ACSH_REVOLVE_CLASS/AcDbShRevolve frames publish their raw carrier while retaining the object-parse failure and skipped counters. Neither change authorizes typed callbacks, graph closure or DXF output.

validation.generated: Both added profiles and previous render profiles: raw bytes and raw publication; no typed callback; following frame delivery; corrupted CRC and object-map mismatch refusal; mismatched revolve class does not publish. The revolve control reaches typed-body failure with a locally constructed prefix.
validation.normal: Generated raw selector, version/class profile selector, and persistent-manager prefix-dispatch CTest passed.
validation.asan: Fully instrumented library and generated raw selector passed.
validation.sourceScreen: All 502 frames of the selected source publish raw or typed carriers; one revolve typed-parse failure and five skipped objects remain. Strict and partial output refuse in ASCII and Binary, preserving the existing destination in all four cases.
validation.legacyRegression: Rebuilt AC1012 partial-output and ownership controls plus AC1014 dictionary observer CTest: 3/3 pass.

limits: An already-issued raw callback from a failed typed history parser is not by itself a successful frame publication; this change publishes only the exact observed R14 class and preserves its failure count.
No producer-native render or revolve semantics, full graph closure, lossless output or organic entity-failure qualification is established.
Downloaded DWG and output files remain outside the repository.
